paragraphs.text: Whispering Woods is a vast forest in North Aerona , part of the Domains of Dominaria .

The Whispering Woods lie northwest of the Wild Woods and east of the Ice Rime Hills , in northern Aerona . This forest, home to many sylvan creatures and elves , was so imbued with magic and mana that it seemed to whisper. Its power strongly affected Greensleeves during her youth. Greensleeves called its Maro-Sorcerer "Spirit of the Forest", but Chaney called him Gaea's Liege . During Dominaria's preparation for the New Phyrexian invasion, the forest manifested a new maro-sorcerer: Greensleeves.

The village White Ridge , the hometown of Gull and Greensleeves, was located in a colorful valley at the border of the forest until it was destroyed in 4073 AR by the wizards Dacian and Towser . A stream that was once a mighty river ran through the village, its banks now replaced by rich riverbed loam teeming with wildflowers. The river's limestone rocks lent the village its name. The village was home to thirty cottages, a mill, and an alehouse. Almost all the inhabitants of White Ridge had names referring to nature - the men's names were related to animals, and the women's were related to plants. A year after the village's destruction, Gull and Greensleeves moved their army into the woods. Their encampment, known as Greensleeves's Grove was composed of dozens of small huts built among the trees, anywhere from five to fifty feet off the ground. Greensleeves oversaw their construction, using only wood pegs and bark ropes. As the village grew between 4074 and 4077, the whispering died down until it was a mere trill.

On the eastern side of White Ridge began the Wild Woods . South of the Whispering Woods lie the Hurloon Mountains . The coastal land west of the Whispering Woods is contested by Keldon raiders and Benalish colonists. The Golden Vale was located near or within the Whispering Woods.
In the novel Whispering Woods , characters describe the Green Lands and Estark as being east and west of the Woods, respectively. In actuality, both lie far south of the Whispering Woods.
